bias.zh: 短线偏空 · 测试 100 日均线

read.en: Micron fell 3.9% on Oct 12 to $989.04, closing below its 30-day average ($1,019) and the $1,017 support from the last read. It is also under the 5 and 10-day averages ($1,037–1,055) but still above the 100-day ($972) and the rising 200-day ($705). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 6 with a widening histogram, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 7, and RSI is 45.
read.zh: 美光 10月12日下跌 3.9%，收于 $989.04，收盘跌破 30 日均线（$1,019）及上次解读中的 $1,017 支撑。股价同时位于 5 日和 10 日均线（$1,037–1,055）下方，但仍高于 100 日（$972）和上行的 200 日均线（$705）。MACD 自 10月6日起位于信号线下方且柱体扩大，抛物线 SAR 自 10月7日起看空，RSI 为 45。

read.en: The 100-day average at $972 (Oct 12 low $978.50) is the key test. Below it, $903 (Sep 14 low) and $888 (Aug 24 low) are next. Resistance is the 30-day average near $1,019, then $1,037–1,055 (5 and 10-day averages) and $1,109, which capped three rallies since Sep 25.
read.zh: $972 的 100 日均线（10月12日低点 $978.50）是关键测试。若跌破，下看 $903（9月14日低点）和 $888（8月24日低点）。阻力为约 $1,019 的 30 日均线，其次 $1,037–1,055（5 日和 10 日均线），以及 9月25日以来三次压制反弹的 $1,109。
